## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its security or privacy impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `make generate`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`
- [ ] No credential, personal document, message content or private path added
- [ ] OAuth, IPC, MIME, archive or model-prompt changes have focused tests
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are current
